test_title: PYST 54: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 08 Sept, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the full form of the NAKSHA programme, the second phase of which was launched in 2025 by the Ministry of Rural Development?

options.text: New Analytical Knowledge for Housing Areas
NAtional geospatial Knowledge-based land Survey of urban HAbitations
National Area Keeping Survey for Habitats

solution:
The correct answer is __**NAtional geospatial Knowledge-based land Survey of urban HAbitations**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The NAKSHA programme stands for **NAtional geospatial Knowledge-based land Survey of urban HAbitations**.
 
• It is an initiative by the **Ministry of Rural Development** aimed at using advanced geospatial technology for land surveys.
 
• The programme's objective is to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of land surveying in urban and semi-urban areas.
 
• NAKSHA employs technologies such as drones, satellite imagery, and Geographic Information Systems (GIS) to map urban habitations accurately.
 
• The second phase of the NAKSHA programme, launched in 2025, focuses on covering a larger area of urban and peri-urban land, ensuring better land management and dispute resolution mechanisms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **For Mapping and Navigation (like NAKSHA's land mapping function)**
 
• The primary "swadeshi" (homegrown Indian) alternative for general mapping is Mappls. 
 
 
• Mappls / MapmyIndia: This is an Indian mapping and navigation tool that offers detailed, hyperlocal maps, doorstep navigation, and real-time traffic updates. 
 
• Google Maps / Google Earth: These are widely used globally for navigation and viewing satellite imagery.
 
• QGIS: If you are looking for professional, open-source Geographic Information System (GIS) software for more in-depth mapping and spatial analysis, QGIS is a popular choice.
